name: European Flood Awareness System (EFAS), Copernicus Emergency Management Service
owner: Copernicus Emergency Management Service (European Commission JRC and ECMWF)

interface: Forecast data is distributed through the Copernicus Climate Data Store (account and token needed, see copernicus-cds); the public site is a map viewer. A keyless data endpoint was not found.
notes: Gap: terms and a keyless interface not found. EFAS access to full forecasts is for registered partners; public map only. Treat as 'waiting for a key' via the CDS unless a keyless endpoint is found.
